author: staurum
text:
Hi Jurij, quick question: recent charts of yours have shown flips of FLs. Are swaps/flips of FLs what you look for to find trade opps? or they just happen to have FL swaps and i just happen to see them?

thanks

author: Jurij
text:
Hi staurum, swap zones are really important.

Swap and QM levels help to see the symmetry in the market, you ideally want a FL (origin or other) to be aligned with such structures.

If you see price stopping in the middle of nowhere, always check for symmetry and more often than not it makes sense.

author: Jurij
text:
Hi althoufx, in such cases where price engulfed a level and you are not entering at the extreme edge then it is a good idea to look for LTF approach/reaction on most recent FL/FTR.

In case of EURAUD there was actually a nice setup:

Why does this help?

Because we know FLs are the edges of a PAZ, the extreme of a zone, so if we get a LTF eng then usually this edge is respected as the intention (signal) was given... Otherwise price can really retrace all the way back down before continuing to the target.

About AUDUSD, I don't see a setup here:

Hope this helps.

BTW let me say it again, if you open a journal and post your successful and failed setups we can see and discuss what went wrong and maybe also what your thought process was/is so that we can help each other accordingly...
